facts.fact: Complaints about train or station services (such as cleanliness) can be lodged through Rail Madad
facts.quote: A) Such grievances may be lodged through RailMadad which can be accessed through the following modes

facts.fact: Rail Madad helpline 139 (general complaints are option 4)
facts.quote: 139 – Integrated Helpline · Security Helpline or Medical Assistance ( 1 ) · Enquiry ( 2 ) · Catering Complaints ( 3 ) · General Complaints ( 4 )

facts.fact: Rail Madad web portal railmadad.gov.in (it now redirects to railmadad.indianrailways.gov.in)
Rail Madad mobile app (Android and iOS)
Complaint by e-mail (the Charter lists 'Email: railmadad.gov.in')
The Complaints & Suggestion Book kept with ticket-checking staff and with the Station Master/Manager
facts.quote: Complaints & Suggestion Book available with Ticket checking staff and with Station Master/Manager.

summary: All channels confirmed on the Railways Citizen Charter (TAG 2026, now at ir.indianrailways.gov.in) plus the WR helpline page for 139.
